backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality including branding configuration, user profiles, product management with view/creation tracking, shopping cart, shop details, Stripe integration, and access control with admin/user permissions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old actor state to new format by adding viewCount and createdAt fields to products, converting cart items to new format, and initializing shopDetails field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including marketplace redesign with dynamic product sections, hero section updates, shop details configuration, and React Query hooks with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and configuration including marketplace, dashboard, checkout flow, product management, and styling with artisan theme.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space with artisan-themed color palette and design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, 'Artisan Hub' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with all application routes (marketplace, dashboard, checkout, legal pages), ThemeProvider, dynamic branding hook, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for managing site branding configuration including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview and progress tracking. Handles image file validation, upload progress callbacks, and persists changes via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for uploading multiple products at once with file selection, auto-copy feature to sync fields across items, and AI-generated product descriptions. Includes progress tracking and batch upload functionality with validation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component displaying branding, navigation links to legal pages (terms, privacy), contact email, and attribution link to caffeine.ai. Dynamically shows shop contact details from backend.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header containing site logo/name, authentication controls, cart badge, and navigation to dashboard and basket. Integrates Internet Identity authentication and renders child routes via Outlet.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Compact product display card showing product image, name, shape, price, and add-to-cart button. Handles cart mutations with loading states and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog for detailed product view with full image, description, details, and action buttons for adding to basket or immediate checkout. Supports buy-now flow via session storage.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table component for managing products with inline editing of name/shape/price, image upload/replacement, and inventory increment functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled profile setup modal component that returns null; previously used for post-login user profile configuration.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form component for configuring shop details including name, address, contact info, opening hours, and company tax details with validation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Setup form component for configuring Stripe payment integration with secret key and allowed countries list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Hook that dynamically updates document title and favicon based on branding configuration from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend API calls including products, cart, orders, user profiles, branding, shop details, and Stripe configuration.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color theme for both light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that handles both single product (buy now) and cart-based checkout flows, displays order summary, and creates Stripe checkout sessions.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with authentication checks, Stripe setup flow, statistics cards, and tabs for product management, bulk upload, branding, and shop settings.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying featured products, most viewed, best selling, and newest products in grid layouts with a hero section and product detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart and buy-now session data, then displays a confirmation message with a continue shopping button.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying information collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, and contact details in a formatted card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page component that displays cart items with quantity controls, removal functionality, and checkout navigation. Shows empty state when cart is empty and calculates total price for all items.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static terms and conditions page displaying legal information about products, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, and liability using a card layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support. Includes functions to get, store, clear, and persist parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography settings with Inter and Crimson Pro fonts, container queries, animations, and custom shadows for the artisan marketplace theme.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting the Artisan Hub marketplace architecture, known issues (image persistence, Buy Now redirect, signup prompts, checkout flow), and existing features including bulk upload, product management, sales tracking, and Stripe integration.
